user.title: Set up hydraXoo
user.description: Zones are added afterwards, from the integration's Configure button.

data_description.weather_entity: Optional for now. It will be used to adjust watering to rain and heat.

data_description.sequence_mode: With one zone at a time, a watering that comes up while another zone is watering waits its turn.

data_description.switch_entity: The plug or relay that opens the solenoid valve.
data_description.max_runtime_min: The valve is always closed after this time, whatever happens.
data_description.power_entity: Consumption of the plug, in W. When set, hydraXoo checks after each closing that the valve really closed.

safety.name: Closing check
safety.description: Used only when a power sensor is set. Some plugs report their consumption only periodically or above a minimum change: set a check delay longer than the plug's reporting interval.

data_description.threshold_w: Below or at this power the valve is considered closed.
data_description.max_attempts: After this many retries the zone is put in fault and stops watering until acknowledged.

data_description.switch_entity: The plug or relay that opens the solenoid valve.
data_description.max_runtime_min: The valve is always closed after this time, whatever happens.
data_description.power_entity: Consumption of the plug, in W. When set, hydraXoo checks after each closing that the valve really closed.

safety.name: Closing check
safety.description: Used only when a power sensor is set. Some plugs report their consumption only periodically or above a minimum change: set a check delay longer than the plug's reporting interval.

data_description.threshold_w: Below or at this power the valve is considered closed.
data_description.max_attempts: After this many retries the zone is put in fault and stops watering until acknowledged.

remove_zone.title: Delete a zone
remove_zone.description: The zone, its cycles and its entities will be deleted.

error.duration_exceeds_max: The duration cannot exceed the safety cut-off.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes. If empty, the zone's base duration is used.

stop_all.name: Stop all zones
stop_all.description: Closes every valve managed by hydraXoo.

pause.name: Pause watering
pause.description: No cycle is started during the pause. Manual watering still works and a watering in progress is not stopped.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days. If empty, until resumed.

acknowledge_fault.name: Acknowledge a closing fault
acknowledge_fault.description: Allows a zone in fault to water again. Check the valve first.

zone_not_found.message: This device is not a hydraXoo zone.

zone_in_fault.message: Zone {zone} is in closing fault. Check the valve, then acknowledge the fault.

safety_failed.message: The valve of zone {zone} still draws {power} W after {attempts} retries. Watering of this zone is blocked. Check the valve and its plug, then acknowledge the fault (service hydraxoo.acknowledge_fault).
